articles.title: A Fire Alarm, a 0.01-Second Gap, and a New Meet Record: Junior Pan Pacs Kicks Off with Drama
articles.summary: A fire alarm delayed the start, but once racing began, Gabi Brito set a meet record in the 50 fly at the Junior Pan Pacs in Vancouver. She beat Australia's Olivia Hine by just 0.28 seconds.

articles.title: After 40 Years of Silence, Ritchie Blackmore Reunites with Deep Purple for One Emotional Song
articles.summary: Ritchie Blackmore shocked fans by joining Deep Purple on stage for 'Smoke on the Water' at Jones Beach—his first time with the band since 1993. He called it a healing moment for old friends.

articles.title: From Gauchos to Iguazú Falls: A Kid's Guide to Argentina's Wild Wonders
articles.summary: Argentina is South America's second-largest country, famous for its gaucho cowboys, the massive Iguazú Falls, and a capital called the 'Paris of South America.' Nearly half the population lives near Buenos Aires.
